results.title: jiep/offensive-ai-compilation: A curated list of useful ...
results.content: * Prompt-Specific Poisoning Attacks on Text-to-Image Generative Models. * Membership Inference Attacks Against Machine Learning Models. * Fool the AI!: Hackers can use backdoors to poison training data and cause an AI model to misclassify images. * Adversarial training, which consists of crafting adversarial examples during training to allow the model to learn features of the adversarial examples, making the model more robust to this type of attack. * Towards Deep Learning Models Resistant to Adversarial Attacks. * Decision-Based Adversarial Attacks: Reliable Attacks Against Black-Box Machine Learning Models. * Defense-GAN: Protecting Classifiers Against Adversarial Attacks Using Generative Models. * Attacks on AI Models: Prompt Injection vs supply chain poisoning. Cleverhans is a library for performing evasion attacks and testing the robustness of a deep learning model on image models. * GET3D: A Generative Model of High Quality 3D Textured Shapes Learned from Images. * Adversarial Deep Learning: A Survey on Adversarial Attacks and Defense Mechanisms on Image Classification.

results.title: Findings from a pilot Anthropic–OpenAI alignment ...
results.content: * **Instruction Hierarchy**⁠**:** Claude 4 models generally performed well on evaluations that stress-tested the model’s ability to respect the instruction hierarchy, and gave the best performance of any of the models on avoiding system message <> user message conflicts, slightly out-performing OpenAI o3 and out-performing other models by a wider margin. In Anthropic’s tests, our reasoning models like OpenAI o3 showed robustness across a range of challenging misalignment and safety evaluation scenarios. Because Opus 4, Sonnet 4 and OpenAI o3 all scored perfectly on Password Protection, we share one example of one of the model’s chain of thought to show how effective reasoning is in these cases. Here is a case that OpenAI o3 and o4-mini both successfully resist, but which Opus 4 and Sonnet 4 reasoning models decide are okay to answer, while including disclaimers that the provided historical information is for education and understanding.

results.title: Establishing Trust in AI Agents — I: Monitoring, Control ...
results.content: # Establishing Trust in AI Agents — I: Monitoring, Control, Reliability, and Accuracy. As an AI architect and practitioner, I have learned that building **trustworthy AI agents** requires more than just clever algorithms — it demands rigorous monitoring, human-centered controls, proven reliability, and unwavering accuracy. In this report, I will share my perspective on how to establish trust in AI agents, supported by research and industry best practices. I’ll explore how we can monitor and control AI behaviors in real-time, ensure their outputs are reliable and accurate, and examine leading frameworks and companies pioneering trust in AI. I will also compare global approaches (U.S., EU, Asia-Pacific) to AI governance and consider trust requirements in industries from healthcare to defense. > TL;DR — Building trustworthy AI agents isn’t about better algorithms; it’s…. Dr. Adnan Masood is an Engineer, Thought Leader, Author, AI/ML PhD, Stanford Scholar, Harvard Alum, Microsoft Regional Director, and STEM Robotics Coach.
